He returns home and begins his struggle with his wife against Medhat to preserve her land.

The three men rush to help her and one is left wondering who will succeed in helping her and who will she fall in love with?

Seif tries to prove his worth by showcasing his singing talent, to the disappointment of the store's owner who fires him. Seif then meets a leftist student and poet, who introduces him to an obscure old composer, and they form a trio and take their art to the streets.

When two friends decide to go to a costume party, they pick police uniforms to don as their costumes, only for their old classmates to mistake them for actual policemen, which puts them in many unexpected situations.

p.d: Mr. Kazem became rich from conning wealthy women, until he accidentally meets the small time crook Tata and they decide to work together. They try to swindle the rich-looking Rika and compete to win her affection.
